headline: ECB invites fintechs to test AI agent payments for the digital euro
body: The European Central Bank opened a call for private companies, including fintechs, payment providers and merchants, to join a new round of its digital euro innovation platform. One exploration track covers AI in payments, including AI agents and the interactions between them, with workshops at the ECB running through the first half of 2027. Applications are due by 17:00 CET on November 9, 2026.
note: Agentic payments rules have so far come from card networks like Mastercard and from the Fed's remarks on authentication. The ECB is now shaping its own view of how AI agents work inside a digital euro, a template every connecting bank and PSP would have to follow.

evidence.text: As part of the preparations for the potential introduction of a digital euro, the Eurosystem is launching a call for expressions of interest inviting private companies and organisations to collaborate in exploring how the digital euro can foster innovation in the market.

Participation in this new wave is open to a broad range of stakeholders, including merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), technical service providers, fintech companies, consumer associations, public institutions and research institutes.

Artificial intelligence (AI) in payments: exploring potential applications of AI in the context of the digital euro, including AI-enabled payment experiences, AI agents and interactions among them, micropayments and innovative user-facing functionalities within payment apps.
Exploration activities will take place via workshops on-site at the European Central Bank premises [ 5 ] in the first and second quarters of 2027.
Submit your application [ 6 ] to DigitalEuroExperimentation@ecb.europa.eu by 17:00 CET on Monday, 9 November 2026.
